change_reason: V5 was stable and beat mean persistence/no-latent RMSE, but failed persistence seed-win and paired-CI gates and was 6.52% worse than the stable OOD-prefix dense model at H20. A scalar Kalman denoising pilot on V5 development seeds did not improve V5 and was rejected. V6 makes one system-level change: prefix backtesting determines nonnegative uncertainty weights for the invariant causal-latent rollout, stable OOD-prefix dense rollout, and persistence. V5 validation is development data only; V6 evidence uses fresh seeds.

development_data_disclosure.rejected_candidate: A scalar prefix Kalman posterior produced H5/H20 path RMSE 0.20730/0.33406 on V5 development seeds versus 0.20678/0.33308 for V5, so it was not promoted.

selected_rule_pilot.rule: At pseudo-origin t=60, inverse-root-MSE weights are computed from a 20-step prefix-only backtest and then frozen for the real origin t=80.

development_data_disclosure.selection_note: Only the weight formula, pseudo-origin, and epsilon are frozen; V6 episode weights use its observed prefix only. V5 results are not counted as V6 evidence.

overrides.hypothesis: A prefix-backtested convex consensus of invariant causal dynamics, calibrated OOD adaptation, and a low-variance persistence anchor will reduce V5 rollout error and restore seed-level robustness on fresh same-loading OOD episodes while remaining noninferior to equal-probe dense consensus.
overrides.claim_boundary: This tests a three-expert prefix-calibrated forecast controller in the same four-chart, fully observed, known-rank-one, matched-basis synthetic family. It is post-prefix conditional-mean forecasting under one fixed OOD loading, not unseen-environment generalization, target-window weight learning, long autonomous simulation, real brain evidence, or AGI.

consensus.weight_error: E_j = mean squared error across prefix leads 61 through 80 and all four charts
consensus.weight_fit_data: Each V6 episode's observed x[0:81] only; no x[81:101] target is read.
consensus.inner_fit: Fit each expert using x[0:61], independently free-roll from x[60] to x[80], and score against the already observed x[61:81].
consensus.outer_refit: Refit the causal residual filter and adaptive expert using x[0:81], then freeze the prefix-derived weights.
consensus.combination: At every lead, take the weighted Euclidean barycenter of three independently generated 20-step component rollouts; never feed the consensus back into a component.
consensus.same_probe_dense_consensus: Replace only the sparse causal component by the all-12-edge equal-probe dense latent component; keep adaptive and persistence components and all weights identical.
consensus.v5_comparator: Evaluate the unmodified sparse causal_latent_free component on the identical V6 episode and truth path.
consensus.metric_definitions: Identical to inherited rollout.metric_definitions; each seed remains the sole independent unit.
